title: eriolaena spectabilis
intro: Eriolaena spectabilis, commonly known as the Yellow Formosan Orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the family Euphorbiaceae. It is a plant native to the tropical regions of the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia, known for its vibrant yellow flowers and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Eriolaena spectabilis include its ability to lower blood sugar levels, exhibit anti-inflammatory properties, and act as an antioxidant. The plant's therapeutic actions include its use in treating various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, with its bioactive constituents including alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids.
